_readme: Edit this file to change conversion factors or mappings - no code changes needed. Factors are pieces per KG ('Conversion Round Off' table).
_factor_mode_readme: reference = formulas and row-4 values exactly as in the approved report (its MD20 HS / MAISA / Perfecta Tag formulas read $I$4, $K$4 and $S$4, and Y4 shows 1200). own_block = every block's Make Cases formula reads its own row-4 cell, filled with that input's factor_key.
_blocks_readme: One entry per brand block on the 'Env & Tag Stock' sheet. kg_col = KG column, cases_col = Can-Make-Cases column, factor_key = the input's own factor (used in own_block mode), factor_cell = the row-4 cell its formula reads in reference mode (default: row 4 of cases_col), machine_lines = Stock Summary 'Machine Line Name' values that feed this column. hs_only=true means only items whose name contains the token 'HS'; hs_excluded=true means items with 'HS' are skipped here (they go to the HS block).
_total_readme: Column AL in the reference report = F+L+P+T (kept exactly as the reference).
_bom_readme: Exploded BOM: the denominator of Make Cases is the 'Qty' (PCS) of the ENV/TAG item per case of the FG. Only FGs whose 'FG Uom' is in case_uoms are used; a qty below min_pcs_per_case is treated as a BOM data error and ignored.
_regions_readme: Items whose name contains one of these markers go to the 'Ghana & AB & AG Stock' sheet instead of the main sheet. 'extra_items' are exact item names that the reference report also lists in that section.
_grouping_readme: Row grouping on the main sheet: an item's row key is its name without the ENV/TAG prefix, cut at the first machine token, plus anything after the trailing 'TBGS' (e.g. (MATADI), -FT, (v2)). Qualifiers listed in ignore_qualifiers are dropped so e.g. 'ENV AL FINA DC ENV (70 GSM)' joins the 'AL FINA' row.

grouping._shared_readme: Row list and order come from the reference report (templates/Tag_Env_Stock_Template.xlsx, column A). A brand-level tag with no row of its own (e.g. TAG BARISSIMO, TAG GV FLAVOUR, TAG ICA COMMON) is placed in the first row of that brand and merged across the brand's rows, as in the manual report. shared_tag_words are dropped to find the brand (ICA COMMON -> ICA). shared_tag_rows pins a tag to a range of reference rows: tag row key -> [first row key, last row key] (row key = name without ENV/TAG and machine tokens).
